label: Google Nest Hub Max smart display
description: Nest Hub Max is a 10-inch Google Assistant display with Chromecast built in, a camera and a Thread border router (802.15.4 at 2.4 GHz) for Matter. It is wireless-only - 802.11 b/g/n/ac Wi-Fi at 2.4 or 5 GHz plus Bluetooth 5.0 - with no Ethernet jack; the only cable it takes is its power adapter.
